$comment: Every Topdan POS IPC channel and the authorisation main enforces for it. tests/unit/market-ipc-contract.test.ts fails when a handler, the preload or this file disagree. auth: none | session | roles:<role,...> | core:<PERMISSION|...>. Every channel also checks the calling frame (assertTrusted). A 'none' channel must say why it is safe before sign-in.

market:activation:refresh.why: Re-checks the licence with the control plane; changes only the licence state the server signs.

market:activation:status.why: Licence mode shown on the lock screen before anyone signs in.

market:app:info.why: App version for the about/support screen.

market:auth:current.why: Restores the persisted operator session (within its absolute cap) before the PIN pad.

market:auth:login.why: Is the sign-in; throttled per account.

market:auth:logout.why: Ends a session; can only reduce access.

market:backup:list.why: Backup file names/sizes for the restore picker; restoring requires BACKUP_MANAGE.

market:backup:status.why: Whether backups are configured, for the settings badge.

market:coreStatus:get.why: Native core state for the status indicator.

market:display:toggle.why: Toggles fullscreen for the local window.

market:printer:health.why: Printer online/offline for the status bar.

market:printer:list.why: Printer names for the status bar and settings.

market:staff:list.why: Staff names/roles for the sign-in picker; credentials never leave main.

market:tenant:login.why: Is the owner-account sign-in against the control plane.

market:tenant:logout.why: Signs the owner account out; can only reduce access.

market:tenant:status.why: Whether an owner account is signed in, before staff sign-in.
